---
id: african-elephant
title: African elephant
---
African elephants (*Loxodonta*) are the largest living land mammals.
Matriarchs remember waterholes and kin across decades. They rumble at
infrasonic frequencies so that distant families stay in social contact
through the ground and air. Tusks are incisors; a trunk is both a nose
and a grasping tool. Savanna and forest forms differ in ear shape and
diet.
